name: ktn
description: KTN-Linter — a strict Go static analysis linter (staticcheck, govet, modernize plus native KTN rules) with a live MCP server for editor diagnostics.

plugins.name: ktn
plugins.description: Wires the ktn-linter MCP server into Claude Code; includes the ktn:ktn skill that installs or upgrades the ktn-linter binary, ktn:ktn-review to review and fix violations across all 446 rules, and ktn:ktn-comments to refactor Go doc-comments to the canonical style.
